---
title: "Summary metrics for paper"
output: html_document
---

This file contains the summary metrics reported in the paper in one place.
```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(scoringutils)
library(tidyr)

# delays
tar_read(clean_weekly_data)

# scores
tar_read(scores_su)
tar_read(scores_ag_su)

# training volume allocation
tar_read(map_tv)
```

# Delays
```{r}
# Average delay time by pathogen in 2024-2025
clean_weekly_data |>
  group_by(pathogen_name, season) |>
  summarise(mean_delay = 7 * sum(count * delay) / sum(count)) |>
  mutate(age_group = "00+") |>
  filter(season == "2024-2025") |>
  kable(caption = "Pathogen specific mean delays 2024-2025")
```

# shortest and longest mean delay across age groups in BAR
```{r}
clean_weekly_data |>
  filter(pathogen == "bar") |>
  group_by(pathogen_name, season, age_group) |>
  summarise(mean_delay = 7 * sum(count * delay) / sum(count)) |>
  filter(season == "2024-2025") |>
  kable(caption = "BAR age-specific mean delays 2024-2025")
```

# RSV delays
```{r}
clean_weekly_data |>
  filter(pathogen == "rsv") |>
  group_by(pathogen_name, season, age_group) |>
  summarise(mean_delay = 7 * sum(count * delay) / sum(count)) |>
  filter(season == "2024-2025") |>
  kable(caption = "RSV age-specific mean delays 2024-2025")
```
